summary: Galmed Pharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders held on September 3, 2026. Per the filing, all proposals described in the proxy statement, as amended, were approved with the requisite majority under Israeli law. No specific vote tallies, proposals, terms, prices, or transaction details are disclosed. This is a routine disclosure of meeting outcomes and contains no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, capital returns, restructuring, or management changes. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No further action or event-specific analysis is applicable; this is a standard post-meeting report.
